tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page. Pure black in the app; milk for print, web and share cards.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels: lists, cards, the tab bar, sheets.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Panels inside a sheet; info chips; pressed rows.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Slider tracks, empty ring track, off stars.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: 1px, full width between rows.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Milk on black, black on milk. All primary text, primary button fill, outlines.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and values. 6.9:1 on black, 6.1:1 on #121212; 6.1:1 on milk.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Inactive tab labels and placeholders only, below 4.5:1 on purpose.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one primary action: a solid block in the text colour. There is no brand accent hue.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Links: text colour, underlined.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a primary block.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fills behind selected chips and tips.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: The only hue in the app: water. Current pour, gram targets, V60 zone. 10:1 on black; 6:1 on milk.

tokens.name: water-deep
tokens.usage: Pours still to come.

tokens.name: taste-acid
tokens.usage: Taste: bright, juicy. Only on cup labels. Black text on every taste tone.

tokens.name: taste-fruit
tokens.usage: Taste: berry, stone fruit.

tokens.name: taste-floral
tokens.usage: Taste: floral, tea-like.

tokens.name: taste-sweet
tokens.usage: Taste: sweet, caramel, balanced.

tokens.name: taste-body
tokens.usage: Taste: chocolate, nutty, heavy body.

tokens.name: taste-off
tokens.usage: Taste for faults: sour, bitter, thin. Grey on purpose.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Saved, synced. Rare.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Delete and errors only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Posters, share cards, covers. Italic, sentence case.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Bean name on Brew and detail sheets; cup-label names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pour 45 g so all the grounds are wet.
styles.usage: Rows, instructions, buttons (regular weight, never bold).

styles.name: value
styles.sample: 15 g of coffee / 250 g of water
styles.usage: The value under a row label.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tabs, section headers, small labels. Uppercase.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: The clock. Tabular figures; tenths at half size.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped sections and cards; chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between thumb and text in a row; between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, row padding, hairline inset.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space above a section header; sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large title top margin; cover insets.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Poster and share-card margins.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, panels, chips, sheets, bars. Square is the brand.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: Only the app icon mask and phone mockups.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and icon buttons: a 1.5px outline in the text colour, no fill.
